tldr: 🔥 Claude Opus 5 dominates benchmarks — #1 on Artificial Analysis, 30.2% on ARC-AGI-3 (4x GPT-5.6 Sol), near-Fable-5 at half price. OpenAI drops three major launches: ChatGPT Voice desktop with full-duplex GPT-Live + Codex, ChatGPT Health to all US users, and Presence enterprise agent service. Sakana's Fugu Ultra v1.1 claims to beat Fable 5 without even routing to it. Kimi K3 goes viral — GPU demand maxed in 48 hours, open weights July 27. Hermes Agent v0.19.0 Quicksilver cuts latency 80% and hits #1 on OpenRouter globally. Alibaba Qwen launches Image-3.0. DeepSeek V4 legacy API cutoff goes into effect. Microsoft's open-weight letter analyzed as Azure land grab. Ultra-tiny Inflect v2 TTS models released — 3.96M params.

articles.title: Claude Opus 5 #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Leaderboard
articles.summary: Opus 5 tops AI leaderboard rankings. 184 HN points, 119 comments. Benchmarks across coding, knowledge work, and reasoning.

articles.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 5 — Official Launch
articles.summary: Flagship model at $5/$25 per MTok. New default on Claude Max, strongest on Pro. Ships mid-conversation tool changes and fallbacks.

articles.title: Anthropic: Opus 5 Delivers Near-Fable-5 Performance at Half the Token Price
articles.summary: Opus 5 hits 30.2% on ARC-AGI-3 — nearly 4x higher than GPT-5.6 Sol. Dominates Frontier-Bench, GDPval-AA, and AutomationBench.

articles.title: Claude Voice Mode Now on Opus and Sonnet — Tool Access
articles.summary: Voice mode upgraded to Opus/Sonnet with Google Calendar, Slack, Notion integration. Supports French, German, Italian, Japanese, Spanish.

articles.title: Claude SDK TypeScript v0.114.0 — New Stop Reason
articles.summary: New stop reason 'model_context_window_exceeded' added to the TypeScript SDK.

articles.title: Claude Agent SDK Python v0.2.127 — Background Task Stdin Fix
articles.summary: Fixed premature stdin closure when background tasks in flight. Stdin stays open until all in-flight tasks complete.

articles.title: ChatGPT Voice on Desktop — GPT-Live Full-Duplex + Codex
articles.summary: Full-duplex voice on desktop. Control Codex and ChatGPT hands-free — create threads, PRs, debug by voice. macOS Appshots.

articles.title: ChatGPT Health Launches to All US Users Over 18
articles.summary: Connect Apple Health, medical records, MyFitnessPal. Personalized health insights. 300M+ health queries per week.

articles.title: OpenAI Presence — Enterprise AI Agent Service
articles.summary: FDE-managed enterprise agents resolving 75% of support issues. BBVA, SoftBank, IAG as design partners.

articles.title: Sakana Fugu Ultra v1.1 Beats Fable 5 Without Routing to It
articles.summary: AI routing model claims up to 7.9 point gain over v1.0. Adds Claude Code-compatible endpoint. Independent verification pending.

articles.title: Microsoft's Open-Weight AI Push Is an Azure Play
articles.summary: Analysis: Microsoft joins open-weight letter to reduce dependency on OpenAI/Anthropic. More models on Azure = less vendor lock-in.

articles.title: Inflect v2 — Ultra-Tiny TTS Models Under 4M and 10M Parameters
articles.summary: Inflect-Nano-v2: 3.96M params (15.97MB). Two complete local TTS models that feel genuinely useful at tiny sizes.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 GA — V4-Pro and V4-Flash Generally Available
articles.summary: 1.6T total/49B active (V4-Pro) and 284B total/13B active (V4-Flash) now GA. 1M context. Agent capabilities and maths reasoning upgrades.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Legacy Model Names Retired — Hard Cutoff
articles.summary: deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner retired July 24 at 15:59 UTC. All API users must migrate to v4-pro or v4-flash.

articles.title: NVIDIA Releases DeepSeek-V4-Pro-NVFP4 on Hugging Face
articles.summary: NVIDIA publishes NVFP4-optimized version of DeepSeek-V4-Pro on Hugging Face for Blackwell GPU inference.

articles.title: Qwen-Image-3.0 — Rich Text-to-Image with 4.5K Token Input
articles.summary: Rich content up to 4.5K tokens, 10px text details, knowledge across 12 languages and 20 font styles. One-step generation of complex graphics.

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS — Studio-Grade Text-to-Speech
articles.summary: Flash (real-time) and Plus (high-quality) modes. Inline emotion tags, free-style natural language control for voice generation.

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime — Conversational Voice with Tools
articles.summary: Real-time conversational model with complex reasoning and agent tool integration. Supports 16 languages, 20 Chinese dialects.

articles.title: Hermes Agent v0.19.0 Quicksilver — 80% Latency Reduction
articles.summary: First-token latency drops from 4.3s to 0.9s. Live subagent streaming, durable delegation ledger, Bitwarden/1Password secret sources.

articles.title: Hermes Agent #1 on OpenRouter Global Token Rankings
articles.summary: Nearly 1,000 contributors. Hermes Agent now the most-used AI app on OpenRouter globally. OSS agent ecosystem leader.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Credential Firewall for Docker Sandboxes
articles.summary: Real keys never enter Docker sandbox — stand-in tokens only. Compromised sandbox tokens are useless elsewhere.

articles.title: Hermes Agent tldraw Offline Skill
articles.summary: Reads open tldraw canvas, edits live, embeds scripts with buttons and state. Install: hermes skills install tldraw-offline.

articles.title: Kimi K3 — 2.8 Trillion Parameter Vision-Language Model
articles.summary: 2.8T MoE vision-language model. Open weights promised by July 27. 1M context. $0.30/MTok cached. Available via API now.

articles.summary: 48 hours post-launch pushed GPU capacity to limit. Splitting into Kimi Membership and Kimi Code Membership. Existing users unaffected.

articles.summary: Microsoft, Meta, NVIDIA, YC sign open-weight petition. Community celebrates as anti-open-source AI lobby 'outgunned.'

articles.title: Zo Computer Adds GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, Luna Models
articles.summary: Added three GPT-5.6 variants: Sol, Terra, and Luna. Terra and Luna support 1M-token context windows on Zo's platform.

articles.title: Zo Computer — Faster Chat Rendering and Service Pause/Resume
articles.summary: Rebuilt rendering pipeline for smooth streaming in long conversations. Pause/resume hosted services keeps URL. Improved memory on paid plans.

articles.title: Dario Amodei: Values-Compatible Business Model at Bloomberg Interview
articles.summary: "If you pick a business model conflicting with values, you betray values or become irrelevant." Widely shared Bloomberg interview.

articles.summary: Nous Research founder: when US models train on everything it's 'training', when Chinese learn from US it's 'theft.' Viral discussion.

articles.summary: Former Fed Chair joins Anthropic LTBT for guidance on macroeconomic effects of AI progress.

articles.summary: YC publishes RFS with 13 areas including defense, AI tutoring, and infrastructure. "We want to defend America."
